content:
The first release candidate v4.5.0-rc1 for the v4.5.0 release of Lean is available now.

This release brings:

  • updates to the widgets framework allowing more persistent widgets
  • more feedback and automation around termination proofs
  • improvements to the output of simp? and simp_all?
  • string gaps and raw strings
    and many bug fixes to Lean and Lake.

Std, Aesop, and Mathlib, have moved their development branches to v4.5.0-rc1, and lean4checker and the repl are available, too, so please go try out the new goodies!

This is a release candidate, so please expect some rough edges. Please report any issues you find! If anyone finds anything that is a regression relative to v4.4.0, we will likely make a new release candidate. Otherwise, we hope for this to become v4.5.0 at the end of January.

If you encounter a problem with the cache, please run lake exe cache get!.
